channel.title: Waka Huia
channel.desc: Through the act of karanga, we traverse both the physical and spiritual realms, guided by ancestral voices that echo through time. This sacred practice is far more than a ritual?it is a powerful form of cultural expression that binds the living with those who have passed on. Within the context of Whiria te hono, a distinguished collective of kaikaranga from Ng?ti Wh?tua ?r?kei, the spiritual and practical responsibilities of this tradition are deeply honoured and carefully upheld. These w?hine carry the weight of generations with each call, embodying the values, stories, and mana of their iwi. (R).
